product_overview: DeelRxCRM is a mobile-first CRM, POS, and inventory management system tailored for regulated, inventory-driven small businesses, emphasizing financial accuracy, inventory traceability, role-based accountability, and operational speed on mobile devices with strong auditability.
core_goals: Ensure financial accuracy with immutable transaction records and audit logs.
Maintain strict inventory traceability and compliance with immutable historical records.
Enforce role-based permissions server-side to ensure accountability.
Optimize POS workflows for mobile, enabling fast, one-handed operation.
Support real-world business workflows with compliance and auditability as priorities.
key_features: Fast mobile-optimized POS supporting fractional quantity sales, price overrides, and tax configurations.
Comprehensive inventory management tracking quantity, weight, and cost per unit, with immutable historical data.
Configurable pricing and tax logic with deterministic and reproducible rules and explicit rounding.
CRM features allowing flexible customer profile creation with purchase history and status flags; no deletion, only soft-disable.
Detailed reporting and audit logs for sales, inventory, tax, user actions, and sensitive financial changes.
Role-based access control across roles including Cashier, Supervisor, Manager, and Super Admin with server-side enforcement.
user_flow_summary: Cashier executes sales with product and customer views, restricted from modifying pricing and tax settings.
Supervisor performs cashier functions with added ability to override prices within limits, void transactions, and adjust inventory with audit logging.
Manager manages products, pricing rules, tax settings, customers, and views reports and analytics.
Super Admin oversees full system access including user and permission management, global settings, and audit logs.
All cross-role actions producing financial or inventory changes generate append-only audit logs for traceability.
validation_criteria: No silent or unlogged data mutations, especially on financial and inventory records.
All financial changes such as price overrides, voids, and refunds must be fully auditable and immutable.
Mobile POS interface must support one-handed operation with efficient workflows allowing new staff to complete sales under 2 minutes.
Historical data, including inventory and transactions, must remain trustworthy and immutable.
Role enforcement verified at both database and API levels ensuring no unauthorized access or operations.
